title: Northgate TV Delivery & Wall-Mount Installation Television-Spend Allowance
content:
On a Northgate Delivery & Installation wall-mounting charge at the Northgate TV Delivery & Wall-Mount Installation level, the labor fee for each television is first lowered by a television-spend allowance. The allowance follows the television merchandise on the purchase being delivered, counted as the amounts of its television sale lines less the amounts of its television returned lines, as the purchase's lines under Northgate Purchases & Returns show them.

| Television merchandise on the purchase (television sale lines less television returned lines) | Allowance off the labor fee for each television |
|---|---|
| $2500.00 or more | $25.00 |
| $1500.00 or more but under $2500.00 | $10.00 |
| Under $1500.00 | None |

The allowance comes off the labor fee for each television itself, so every amount worked out from the per-television labor fee is worked out from the lowered fee. Only television lines count; other merchandise on the same purchase is not part of the television merchandise.

## Both sides of each band

| Television merchandise | Allowance per television |
|---|---|
| $2500.00 | $25.00 |
| $2499.99 | $10.00 |
| $1500.00 | $10.00 |
| $1499.99 | None |

**Hypothetical purchase.** Television sale lines of $2800.00 with one television line of $700.00 returned leave $2100.00 of television merchandise: $10.00 off the labor fee for each television.
